in_arabic.name: لطيفة
in_arabic.meaning: لطيفة تعني اللطف و الجمال و الحسن

in_english.name: Lateeha
in_english.long_meaning: The name Lateeha originates from the Arabic root 'l-ṭ-f', which means beauty, kindness, and goodness. It is mentioned in the Quran in Surah An-Naml verse 23. The name signifies a person with a gentle and lovely nature. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing elegance and spiritual significance.
